text:
Eli: Ping — got a PO from Meridian Health for a POC. Need to route MSA/DPA redlines, get billing info on the order form, and figure out signature path. PO attached: PO-2026-4567. They require Net30 and a KMS clause for key management. Who can own legal + finance review?

Sara: I'm on it, adding the PO and our proposed order form. Seen some redlines on the DPA already (data residency EU clause). Link: https://redwood-docs/internal/meridian (internal)

Jordan (Legal): I'll take the DPA/MSA. Quick q: does Meridian insist on customer-managed keys or will a KMS appendix suffice? Need the security questionnaire answers too. Could someone dump the SOC2 + encrypt-at-rest language we used with Acme?

Mike (Finance): FYI procurement says invoice must include tax ID and exact billing addr. Also need to confirm whether they can do EFT or require paper check. If Net30, revenue recognition needs a signed SOW or signed order form.

Priya (RevOps): For signatures we'll use DocuSign envelope. Routing plan: signer order = (Meridian PO sig) -> (Redwood exec sig) -> cc billing + legal. Can we get the exec signer name? Also we should set reminder at 3 business days. :thumbsup:

Eli: Exec signer is CTO (Amir Khalid). Can legal pre-approve redline so we don't wait on our exec? Also confirm whether KMS clause needs HSM mention.

Jordan (Legal): We can pre-approve a KMS appendix with optional HSM language. I'll post a redline by EOD. If Meridian insists on customer-managed keys, we need to check Private deployment pricing.

Sara: Adding quick order form snippet for finance to review:
```
bill_to: "Meridian Health, Inc."
tax_id: "98-7654321"
billing_address: "120 Health Plaza, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110"
po_number: "PO-2026-4567"
payment_terms: "Net30"
```

Mike (Finance): Confirmed. Also need to verify contractual contact for invoicing (name + email). Send to finance@redwood.com once they confirm.

Jordan (Legal): Posting initial redline now. Key ops: add Appendix KMS, add DPA paragraph for EU data residency, add SLA uptime target 99.9% with fallbacks. Please review and flag any product blocking items.

Priya (RevOps): DocuSign draft created: envelope id env-7765. Routing workflow set. I'll add Billing (billing@meridian.com) as CC and Jordan as approver.

ContractBot: Created orderform-PO-2026-4567 and linked to contract CR-2026-089.

Eli: Great. Next actions: Jordan to post redline (EOD), Mike to confirm billing contact (today), Priya to start DocuSign and set reminders, Sara to confirm whether Meridian needs customer-managed keys (reach out to their security contact).

Sara: pinging security contact now. I'll post update when they reply.

Jordan (Legal): redline posted: https://redwood-contracts/internal/redlines/CR-2026-089 — noted KMS appendix draft. If anyone sees product constraints (Private deployment pricing), flag here.

Mike (Finance): Billing contact: Claire B. (claireb@meridian.com). Claire confirmed EFT ok.

Eli: Thanks all — moving to active. I'll update the CRM and set task reminders. :white_check_mark:
